terms.comment: A town takes no preposition: Angelopolim (to), Angelopolī (at), Angelopolī (from).

evidence: M-O s.v. California: Los Angelos (diocesan synod, 1889)

sources: Morgan–Owens, Adumbratio: s.v. California: Los Angelos.
